steps.summary: Signed in to Odoo as admin, navigated to the Contacts app via Sales > Orders > Customers (the res.partner Contacts view — no separate top-level Contacts app was installed), and created a new contact named exactly "rpod1-r2 Bench Customer" (default Company type) with City "Benchville". Saved successfully (record id=45, "Contact created" notification shown). Verified by returning to the Customers kanban and reopening record id=45: the form displays Name "rpod1-r2 Bench Customer" and City "Benchville". Note: this Odoo build's contact form exposes no explicit Customer checkbox (no boolean fields exist in the form view); the contact was created in the Customers context and appears in the Customers list. Screenshots captured at save and verification states.

Contact 'rpod1-r2 Bench Customer' (Company type, Customer) with City 'Benchville' was already created and is open on the form page. Both values verified: Name = "rpod1-r2 Bench Customer", City = "Benchville". No re-creation needed.

Created and saved quotation S00022 (id=22) in the Odoo Sales app for customer 'rpod1-r2 Bench Customer' (selected from the autocomplete dropdown, showing Benchville). Added exactly one order line: product 'Conference Chair' [E-COM12] selected from the product catalogue dropdown, quantity set to 3.00. The app auto-filled the unit price at £ 33.00 and computed Untaxed Amount £ 99.00 (TAX 20% £ 19.80, Total £ 118.80). All values verified on the saved record after the save navigation.

Opened quotation S00022 for customer 'rpod1-r2 Bench Customer', entered edit mode, and added a second order line: product 'Customizable Desk' [FURN_0096] selected from the product catalogue autocomplete dropdown, quantity set to 2.00 via the product configurator dialog. The app auto-filled the unit price at £ 750.00. The first line (Conference Chair, qty 3.00, £ 99.00) was left untouched. Saved the quotation — the new total Untaxed Amount is £ 1,599.00 (TAX 20% £ 319.80, Total £ 1,918.80), reflecting both lines. All values verified on the saved record.

Opened quotation S00022 for customer 'rpod1-r2 Bench Customer', clicked Edit, changed the first order line (Conference Chair) quantity from 3 to 5. The second line (Customizable Desk, qty 2) was left untouched. Saved the quotation — the app recomputed the new total Untaxed Amount as £ 1,665.00 (first line now £165.00 + second line £1,500.00 = £1,665.00; TAX 20% £333.00, Total £1,998.00). All values verified on the saved record.

Opened quotation S00022 for customer 'rpod1-r2 Bench Customer' in Odoo Sales. Found two stray blocking modals (an email composer and an "Edit: rpod1-r2 Bench Customer" dialog) left over from earlier attempts that were intercepting the Confirm clicks — discarded both. Then clicked the Confirm button, which changed the record's status. Verified on the reloaded record: the order reference shown is "S00022" and the statusbar now shows "Sales Order" as the current status (data-value=sale, aria-checked=true). Screenshot captured as evidence.

Opened sales order S00022 for customer 'rpod1-r2 Bench Customer' in Odoo Sales. Clicked the Cancel button in the header, which opened a "Cancel Sales Order" confirmation modal (with a native alert "Are you sure you want to cancel this order?"). Clicked the modal's primary "Cancel" button to confirm the cancellation. Verified after a full page reload: the statusbar now shows "Cancelled" as the current status (aria-checked=true), and the header buttons changed from "Create Invoice / Send by Email / Preview / Cancel" to "Preview / Set to Quotation", confirming the Cancel action succeeded. Screenshot captured as evidence.

Record S00022 for customer 'rpod1-r2 Bench Customer' (Benchville) is in status "Cancelled". Two order lines: (1) Conference Chair, qty 5.00; (2) Customizable Desk, qty 2.00. Untaxed Amount: £ 1,665.00. All values verified from the live page without any state changes.
